query_text: Zucchini, tomatoes and parmesan
title: Zucchini Salad with Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 small zucchini; 4 green onions; 1 clove garlic, minced; 3 tablespoons wine vinegar; 12 cup corn oil; 3 -4 ripe tomatoes, sliced; salt, &amp pepper; minced parsley; 1 pinch dried basil
directions: 1. Tip and wash zucchini, slice very thinly and place in bowl with sliced green onions. 2. Blend garlic, vinegar, corn oil, salt and basil and pour over vegetables. 3. Cover, place in fridge until chilled. 4. Line dish with tomatoes and top with marinated zucchini. 5. Garnish with parlsey and pepper to taste.

query_text: Zucchini, tomatoes and parmesan
title: Tomato-Zucchini Bake
ingredients: Cooking spray; 1 pound sliced zucchini; 1 1/2 cups fresh or frozen corn kernels; 1 1/4 pounds sliced vine-ripened tomatoes; 1/2 cup panko; 1/4 cup finely grated Parmesan
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°. Coat a 2-quart shallow baking dish with cooking spray, and alternately layer sliced zucchini, corn kernels, and sliced tomatoes. Combine panko and Parmesan, and sprinkle on top. Bake, uncovered, in the center of oven 30 minutes or until top is golden brown. Cover with foil, and bake for 10 minutes more or until vegetables are tender. Serve immediately.

query_text: Zucchini, tomatoes and parmesan
title: Asparagus And Zucchini Sauté
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter; 2 garlic cloves (finely chopped); 1 leek (sliced 1/2 thick); 4 large mushrooms (sliced); 1/2 lb asparagus; 1 small zucchini (unpeeled); 1 medium tomatoes; salt & freshly ground black pepper; grated fresh parmesan cheese (to garnish)
directions: 1. Cut off stalk ends of asparagus and throw away. Cut off tips and reserve in bowl. Cut the remaining stalk in halves or thirds (your discretion). 2. Slice the zucchini in half and then slice up in bite-size chunks. 3. Melt the butter in a frying pan. 4. Add finely chopped garlic, slice leeks and saute until browned. 5. Add mushrooms to the fry pan and saute for 3-5 minutes. 6. Add asparagus (except for tips) and zucchini to the fry pan. 7. Add salt and fresh ground black pepper. 8. Cover and simmer until tender; about 10 minutes. 9. Add tomatoes and asparagus tips and cook for a further 5 minutes until the tomatoes are cooked but not mushy. 10. Garnish with grated fresh parmesan cheese.

query_text: Zucchini, tomatoes and parmesan
title: Omelet Arnold Bennett
ingredients: 12 oz (350g) smoked haddock fillet (finnan haddie); 8 large eggs, separated; 1/2 cup half and half; 4 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan; Freshly ground black pepper; 4 tbsp butter
directions: 1. Place the fish in a saucepan and add enough cold water to cover. 2. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, and simmer about 7 minutes, until the fish is hot and flakes easily. 3. Drain. 4. Remove the skin and bones and flake the fish. 5. Whisk the egg whites in a bowl until soft peaks form. 6. Beat the yolks with 2 tbsp of the half-and-half in another bowl. 7. Fold in the whites. 8. Add the fish and 2 tbsp of the Parmesan. 9. Season with pepper. 10. Preheat the broiler. 11. Melt the butter in a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat. 12. When foaming, add the egg mixture. 13. Cook, lifting up the sides of the omelet as they set with a rubber spatula, allowing the uncooked egg mixture to run underneath the cooked portion, about 3 minutes, or until the omelet is almost set but the top is uncooked. 14. Sprinkle the remaining 2 tbsp of Parmesan over the omelet. 15. Pour the remaining half-and-half over the top. 16. Broil until the top of the omelet is set and lightly browned. 17. Serve immediately, straight from the pan.

query_text: Zucchini, tomatoes and parmesan
title: Zucchini Pizza
ingredients: 6 Zucchini (skin on), brushed and halved; 5 large Tomatoes (or one can of dice tomatoes), pureed; 2 tbsp Tomato puree
directions: 1. Using a food processor or a blender, puree tomatoes, add tomato puree, pulse, add 1 teaspoon of garlic. 2. Stir until they are well mixed. 3. Transfer halved zucchinis into greased baking tray, cook until they lose their firmness about 20 minutes. 4. Slide tray out and spread sauce into zucchinis. 5. First divide cheese then all other toppings into zucchinis, and transfer back to oven and cook until pepperoni and cheese change their color.

query_text: Sweet potatoes, black beans, chili powder and lime
title: Chili-Crusted Salmon With Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili powder; 1 tablespoon brown sugar; 1 teaspoon salt; 1 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced; 3 green onions, chopped; 1 tablespoon olive oil; 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper; 24 ounces salmon fillets, cut into 4 pieces
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 450. 2. In small mixing bowl, combine chili powder, brown sugar, and salt. 3. In 13 x 9 glass baking dish, toss potatoes with onion, olive oil, pepper, and 1 Tbsp of the chili mixture until evenly coated. Cover with foil and roast 20 minutes. 4. Meanwhile, use remaining chili mixture to coat salmon fillets. Place on top of potatoes, skin side down, and roast uncovered 10-12 minutes, or until fish flakes easily and potatoes are tender.

query_text: Sweet potatoes, black beans, chili powder and lime
title: Yummy, Spicy Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 14 onion, diced; 14 green pepper, diced (optional); 2 garlic cloves, pressed; 2 tablespoons olive oil; 1 tablespoon cumin; 1 -2 tablespoon chili powder; 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper (adjust according to taste); 1 teaspoon oregano; 1 teaspoon salt; 1 tablespoon tomato paste or 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup; 1 (14 ounce) can black beans, drained; 2 cups chicken broth or 1 (14 ounce) can diced tomatoes with juice; cooked white rice or brown rice; low-fat sour cream (optional); shredded cheddar cheese (optional); green onion, chopped (optional)
directions: 1. Heat oil in large skillet over med-high heat. 2. Add onions and peppers and saute until onions are soft and translucent. 3. Add garlic, cumin, chili powder, cayenne pepper, oregano, salt, tomato paste. 4. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until fragrant. 5. Add black beans, mix to combine. 6. Add chicken broth. 7. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer about 20 minutes or until most of liquid has been absorbed. 8. Serve over rice topped with a dollop of low-fat sour cream, shredded cheddar cheese, and chopped green onions. 9. YUM!

query_text: Sweet potatoes, black beans, chili powder and lime
title: Black Bean And Sweet Potato Chili (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil; 1 medium red onion, chopped; 1 red pepper, chopped; 4 garlic cloves, minced; 2 teaspoons sea salt; 1 large sweet potato, cut into 1/2-inch cubes; 1 lime, zest and juice of; 1 (28 ounce) can diced tomatoes; 4 (15 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained (or 6 cups freshly cooked); 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped; 1 tablespoon cumin; 1 tablespoon chili powder; 1 tablespoon cocoa powder; 1 lime, cut into wedges (optional -- for garnish); 1 cup chopped cilantro leaf, washed and dried (optional -- for garnish)
directions: 1. Warm the oil in a large pan over medium heat and add the onion, red pepper, garlic, and salt. Saute until soft, about 4 minutes. 2. Add the sweet potato and lime zest, cook 10-15 minutes more, continuing to stir occasionally. 3. Add the tomatoes, black beans, jalapeno, lime juice, cumin, chili powder, and cocoa; bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 10 minutes. 4. OR omit the oil, throw everything in a crock pot, and cook on high for 6 hours. 5. Serve over brown rice with lime wedges and cilantro.

query_text: Sweet potatoes, black beans, chili powder and lime
title: Roasted Vegetable And Black Bean Tacos
ingredients: 1 small red onion, chopped; 1 poblano chile, seeded and chopped; 1 small zucchini, chopped; 1 sweet potato, peeled and chopped; 3 tablespoons olive oil; 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt; 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper; 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin; 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano; 1/4 teaspoon smoked paprika; Pinch of cayenne pepper; 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed; 1 lime, juiced; 1/2 cup buttermilk; 1/4 cup sour cream; 8 corn tortillas; 1/2 cup crumbled cotija cheese
directions: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Toss the onion, poblano chile, zucchini, and sweet potato with the olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin, oregano, paprika, and cayenne. Spread into an even layer on a large rimmed baking sheet. Roast for about 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Remove from the oven and stir in the black beans and lime juice. 2. Whisk together the buttermilk and sour cream in a small bowl. To serve, divide the roasted vegetables between the tortillas. Top each taco with the crumbled cotija cheese and a drizzle of crema.

query_text: Sweet potatoes, black beans, chili powder and lime
title: Black Bean And Sweet Potato Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes; cooking spray; 1 (3 ounce) package cream cheese, softened; 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed; 1/4 cup chopped green onion; 1 teaspoon chili powder; 1 teaspoon ground cumin; 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano; salt to taste; 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper; 4 (10 inch) flour tortillas; 1 (10 ounce) can enchilada sauce; 1 cup shredded Mexican cheese blend
directions: 1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Boil sweet potatoes until tender, about 30 minutes. Cool until easily handled, about 10 minutes. Slip off peels. 2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease an 8x10-inch baking dish with cooking spray. 3. Mash sweet potatoes with cream cheese in a bowl. Stir in black beans, green onion, chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper until well mixed. 4. Place 3/4 cup sweet potato mixture in the center of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas and place seam-side down in the prepared baking dish. Pour enchilada sauce over tortillas. Sprinkle Mexican cheese blend on top. 5. Bake in the preheated oven until the enchilada sauce is bubbling and the cheese is beginning to brown, about 25 minutes.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Creamy Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter; 3 cloves garlic minced; 16 ounces cremini mushrooms thinly sliced; 1/3 cup heavy cream; 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme; 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano; kosher salt; 2 tablespoons freshly grated Parmesan; 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves chopped
directions: 1. Melt butter in a large skillet oven over medium heat. Add garlic and mushrooms, and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and browned, about 5-6 minutes. 2. Stir in heavy cream, thyme and oregano; season with salt and pepper, to taste. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until slightly reduced and thickened, about 5-6 minutes. Stir in Parmesan. 3. Serve immediately, garnished with parsley, if desired.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Creamy Mushrooms & Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cups Butter; 2 Tablespoons Olive Oil; 1/2 cups Flour; 1 Tablespoon Dried Sage; 1 package Chicken Legs Or Pieces (5 Or 6 Pieces Total); 1 clove Garlic, Minced; 8 ounces, weight Mushrooms, Sliced; 4 Tablespoons Flour; 3 cups Milk Or Half-and-Half; Salt And Pepper, to taste
directions: 1. 1) In a large skillet, melt 4-5 Tablespoons of butter over medium heat. 2. Once melted add a couple Tablespoons of olive oil. 3. While butter and oil are heating up combine flour, sage and some salt & pepper (to taste). 4. Throw a pinch of flour into butter/oil and see if it sizzles a little. 5. If so, dredge chicken in flour mixture and carefully add to pan. 6. 2) Cook until chicken pieces are brown on all sides, then place them in an oven-safe dish & cover with aluminium foil. 7. Bake for 15-20 minutes at 375 degrees, until cooked throughout. 8. 3) While chicken is baking: The chicken should have absorbed most of the butter/olive oil in your skillet. 9. If so, add a couple more tablespoons of butter to your skillet. 10. Add garlic to pan and saute until slightly caramelized. 11. Then add a couple more tablespoons of butter I did mention this was a Julia Child inspired recipe right?!?! 12. and the mushrooms. 13. Cook over medium heat until mushrooms have cooked down and are soft. 14. 4) Next, add 4 Tablespoons of flour (NOT the flour you used to dredge the chicken, NO! 15. That should have been tossed out already) to the mushrooms in pan. 16. Slowly add milk (or half and half), stirring carefully. 17. Turn heat to medium/low and let sauce simmer. 18. It will slowly thicken, be sure to stir occasionally. 19. Now, taste! 20. (you may want to add more salt, pepper and even a couple more pinches sage. 21. And hey, not buttery enough? 22. Add a couple more tablespoons of that while you are at it!) 23. 5) By now, your chicken pieces should be cooked thru remove them from the oven and place into your creamy, mushroomy sauce. 24. Mmmmm. 25. Let simmer for just a few moments. 26. The chicken will soak up a little sauce, so you may want to add a smidge more milk. 27. 5) Serve. 28. NOTES: I cooked Angel Hair Pasta while the sauce was simmerin and a thickenin. 29. To serve, I placed the chicken legs over the pasta and poured on all the yummy sauce. 30. Be sure to make lots of sauce. 31. This would be great over rice or mashed potatoes.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Cream Chicken With Parsley
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. cut up frying chicken*; 1/4 tsp. salt; 1 c. heavy cream; 1/4 c. chopped parsley; 3 Tbsp. butter; 1/4 tsp. pepper (white or freshly ground black); parsley sprigs
directions: 1. *Individual pieces (i.e. breasts, thighs) may be used.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Mushroom Herb Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. mushrooms; 1/2 c. melted butter; 1/2 tsp. marjoram; 1 tsp. salt; 1 Tbsp. chopped chives; 4 Tbsp. chicken broth; 2 Tbsp. heavy cream (sour cream)
directions: 1. Wash mushrooms lightly. 2. Put in shallow casserole. 3. Add marjoram, salt and chives to butter. 4. Pour over mushrooms. 5. Mix chicken broth and cream. 6. Pour into casserole. 7. Cover and bake 20 minutes at 375°. 8. Remove cover last 5 minutes. 9. Serves 4.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Herbed Salmon With Creamy Champagne-Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, 1-inch thick, skin removed; 4 tablespoons butter; 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves; 2 cups fresh sliced mushrooms; 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice; 1/2 cup champagne (or white wine); 2 tablespoons flour; 1 cup heavy cream; Thyme sprigs for garnish
directions: 1. Melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. 2. Saute fresh thyme leaves in butter 1 minute, or until fragrant. 3. Add salmon fillets to skillet in single layer. Baste fillets thoroughly with butter. 4. Add mushrooms to skillet. 5. Pour lemon juice and champagne over all. 6. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cover skillet and simmer 25 minutes, or until salmon flakes easily with fork. 7. Transfer salmon to plate. 8. Sprinkle flour over mushrooms and drippings in skillet. Increase heat to medium-high and cook, stirring, 1 minute. 9. Whisk in cream and cook, stirring, 2 minutes more, or until sauce is thickened. 10. Return salmon to skillet to heat through. 11. To serve, place salmon on plates. Spoon sauce over top. Garnish with thyme sprigs.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Chicken Bacon Beef Dish Recipe
ingredients: 4-5 deboned chicken breasts; 4 ounce. dry beef; 1/2 pt. lowfat sour cream; 2-3 slices bacon; 1 can mushroom soup; 1 sm. can sliced mushrooms
directions: 1. Wrap each deboned chicken breast with 1/2 slice bacon. 2. Layer dry beef on bottom of casserole. 3. Place wrapped chicken to top. 4. In bowl mix mushroom soup, lowfat sour cream and mushrooms. 5. Pour over chicken and bake at 275 degrees for 3 hrs, uncovered.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Pan Fried Sea Bass
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil; 2 tablespoons butter, divided; 2 (6 to 8-ounce) fillets sea bass, skin on; Salt and freshly ground black pepper; 1/3 cup vermouth; 4 sprigs fresh thyme; Pinch saffron; 1/4 cup heavy cream
directions: 1. Heat a large skillet with olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter. 2. Season the fillets with some salt and pepper. 3. Place fillets in skillet and cook about 5 minutes on each side. 4. When the fish is cooked, set aside on a plate and deglaze the pan with the vermouth, add the thyme and saffron leaving to bubble until it's reduced by two thirds. 5. Add remaining butter and whisk followed by the heavy cream and heat through. 6. Serve fillets with light saffron cream sauce and blanched asparagus.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Creamed Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. butter or margarine; 2 green onions, minced; 12 oz. mushrooms, chopped coarsely; 1/4 c. flour; 1 tsp. salt; 1/8 tsp. cayenne; 2 1/2 c. milk
directions: 1. Melt butter in heavy saucepan. 2. Add onions and mushrooms. Cover; cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender and juices released, about 6 minutes. 3. Blend in flour, salt and cayenne. 4. Gradually stir in milk. 5. Cook and stir until thickened, about 5 minutes. 6. Makes 3 cups.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Creamy Herbed Chicken And Mushrooms With Rice
ingredients: 1 liter chicken stock (salt reduced); 1 1/4 cups long grain rice; 1 tablespoon oil; 500 g chicken breast fillets (cut into thin strips); 200 g button mushrooms (sliced); 1 onion (medium, sliced); 1 teaspoon thyme (dried); 1 tablespoon cornflour (cornstarch); 200 g green beans (halved); 1/3 cup sour cream
directions: 1. Place 1 1/2 cups (625ml) stock in a saucepan over high heat and bring to the boil, stir in the rice, cover reduce heat to low and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until rice is tender and stock has been absorbed. 2. Meanwhile heat oil in a large frying pan and add chicken and cook, in batches and cook for 5 minutes or until golden, remove and set aside. 3. Add mushrooms, onion, thyme and 1/2 cup (125ml) stock and cook for 5 minutes, stirring until vegetable soften, remove and set to one side. 4. In a bowl or jug, combine cornflour with remaining stock until evenly mixed and pour into the frying pan and stir the mushrooms and beans back in and bring to the boil, stirring constrantly and then reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occassionally until beans are tender and then return chicken to the frying pan and stir in the sour cream and cook until heated through. 5. Serve over the rice.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: One Pot Zucchini Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound spaghetti; 1 pound thinly sliced mushrooms; 2 zucchini, thinly sliced and quartered; 2 cloves garlic, thinly sliced; 2 sprigs thyme; sea salt; freshly ground black pepper; 1/3 cup grated parmesan; 1/4 cup heavy cream
directions: 1. In a large stockpot over medium high heat, combine spaghetti, mushrooms, zucchini, garlic, thyme, and 4 1/2 cups of water. 2. Season with salt and pepper. 3. Bring to a boil. 4. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until pasta is cooked through and liquid has reduced, about 8-10 minutes. 5. Stir in parmesan and heavy cream.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained; 3 to 4 servings cooked chicken; 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup; 1/3 c. milk; 1/2 c. shredded cheese
directions: 1. Arrange broccoli in baking dish. 2. Top with chicken. 3. Blend soup and milk. Pour over all. 4. Top with cheese. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until hot. 5. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Magic Chicken Pies
ingredients: 1 chicken breast (either roasted or equivalent quantity of 'leftovers' or poached in water with some peppercorns, pars); 25 g butter; 1 leek, sliced; 5 mushrooms, sliced approx; 2 tablespoons flour; 250 ml milk; 300 g potatoes, cooked and cut into small cubes; 1 teaspoon thyme; 2 2 sheets flaky pastry dough or 2 sheets shortcrust pastry; salt and pepper; 1 egg, beaten
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 200°. Saute the leeks and mushrooms in the butter till soft, stir in the flour and gradually add the milk until a thick sauce is formed. Add the potato, thyme and the chicken breast shredded. Season with salt and pepper and allow to cool. Grease a medium muffin pan with cooking spray. Line muffin pans with pastry. I find an empty 800g tomato tin or 400g tuna tin cuts just the right size circles for the muffin pans. Press the pastry in gently (re rolling the pastry until all the pans are lined). Spoon in the chicken filling. Using the pastry trimmings cut strips of pastry - four for each pie, and lattice the pastry strips on the top of each pie. You will need to dab a little cold water onto the ends of the pastry strips and press them down firmly so they don't pop up as the pastry cooks. 2. Brush lightly with beaten egg and bake for 20 minutes or until golden.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter; 1/4 lb. fresh sliced mushrooms or 1 (4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms; 2 c. diced, cooked chicken; 1 pt. heavy cream or half and half; salt and pepper to taste; 2 Tbsp. flour; 2 Tbsp. butter, melted; 1/4 lb. spaghetti, cooked; 6 oz. Mozzarella cheese, sliced; 2 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
directions: 1. Melt butter in skillet; add mushrooms and saute 3 minutes. Add chicken, cream, salt and pepper. 2. Heat to almost boiling. 3. In a small bowl, make a smooth paste from flour and 2 tablespoons butter. 4. Stir into the chicken mixture and stir until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened. 5. Simmer 5 minutes. 6. Spread spaghetti on bottom of buttered 8-inch square pan. 7. Layer the Mozzarella cheese over the chicken, working the first layer of slices down into the chicken mixture a little. 8. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese slices. 9. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on last. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Chicken and rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice; 1 chicken breasts; 1 cup milk; 1 cup water; 1 can cream of mushroom; 1 can cream of chicken mushroom; 1 packages French's onions
directions: 1. Put rice in baking dish 2. Add milk, water and both soups 3. Lay chicken on top 4. Sprinkle with French's onions 5. Cover and cook 350 1 hr 20 min

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Crushed Potatoes with Cream and Garlic
ingredients: new potatoes 1 pound (500g); new garlic 3 juicy cloves; heavy cream 1 cup (250ml); thyme about 8 sprigs
directions: 1. Scrub the potatoes but do not peel them. 2. Boil them in a pan of deep, lightly salted water for fifteen to twenty minutes or so, until tender. 3. While the potatoes are boiling, peel and lightly crush the garlic cloves. 4. Pour the cream into a small saucepan, and add the leaves from the sprigs of thyme, the garlic, a little salt, and some black pepper. 5. Let the mixture simmer over medium heat until it has reduced by about a third. 6. Once the potatoes are drained, put them in a shallow dish and crush each one lightly with a forkyou want to break the skin and flatten the potato just enough for its flesh to soak up some of the hot cream. 7. Pour the cream and thyme over the crushed potatoes and eat while hot.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Schrafft'S Chicken A La King
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter; 1/2 c. flour; dash of paprika; 2 c. hot chicken stock; 1/2 c. heavy cream; 1/4 c. milk, scalded; 2 slightly beaten eggs; 2 c. cooked chicken, cut in strips; 1 c. mushrooms, sauteed in butter; 1/2 tsp. salt; 1/2 c. pimento strips; toast or patty shells
directions: 1. Melt butter; add flour and paprika. 2. Blend. 3. Slowly add chicken stock, cream and milk, stirring constantly. 4. Cook 5 minutes on low heat. 5. Remove from stove and add egg yolks, chicken, mushrooms, salt and pimento strips. 6. Can be served over toast or patty shells.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Creamed Chicken With Mushrooms - Atkins - 4.5 Net Carbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken cutlets, cut into 1-inch pieces; salt and pepper, to taste; 2 teaspoons thyme, chopped fresh or 1/2 teaspoon thyme, dried; 3 tablespoons butter, divided; 2 cups mushrooms, sliced; 1/2 cup shallot, minced; 2/3 cup white wine, dry; 2/3 cup chicken broth, reduced sodium; 2/3 cup heavy cream; 1/4 cup parsley, chopped fresh
directions: 1. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and thyme. 2. Heat 2 tbsp butter in skillet until foam subsides. Add chicken and cook over med-high heat for about 3 min, until light golden. 3. Add mushrooms, cook for 2 min, stirring occasionally. 4. Transfer mixture to plate and keep warm. 5. Melt remaining 1 tbsp butter in skillet over med heat. 6. Add shallots and cook 2 minute. 7. Stir in wine and broth, scraping up browned bits from bottom of pan and bring to a boil. 8. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minute 9. Add cream and gently simmer 5 minute. 10. Return chicken/mushroom mixture to skillet, stir in parsley, and heat through. Serve immediately.

query_text: Mushrooms, heavy cream, thyme and chicken
title: Party Chicken
ingredients: 8 large split chicken breasts, boned and skinned or use boneless halves; 8 slices bacon; 1 (4 oz.) pkg. dried beef; 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup; 1 c. sour cream
directions: 1. Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon. 2. Arrange dried beef in a 9 x 13-inch pan (or smaller). 3. Place chicken on dried beef. 4. Combine soup and sour cream. 5. Pour over chicken. Bake, uncovered, at 275° for 3 hours. 6. Serves 8.

query_text: A soup with lentils, carrots, celery, onion and cumin
title: Southwestern Chili
ingredients: 200 g long-grain rice; 2 cloves garlic, peeled and chopped finely; 2 None onions, chopped finely; 200 g carrots, peeled and cubed; 200 g celery, cut into small pieces (keep the leaves for garnish); 1 can (425ml) chopped tomatoes; 1 bunch oregano, chopped; 2-3 tbsp olive oil; 500 g minced beef; 250 litre vegetable stock; 1 can (425ml) kidney beans, drained; 1 pinch chill powder; 1 pinch dried cumin
directions: 1. Cook the rice according to the package directions. 2. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic and onions and cook for 5 mins, stirring often. Add the beef, increase the heat to medium-high and cook until browned, breaking up pieces with a wooden spoon. Spoon off the excess fat. Add the tomatoes, broth, carrots, celery, cumin, oregano and chili powder. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 mins, stirring occasionally. Stir in the beans and simmer for 5 mins. Divide among four bowls, top with the rice and garnish with celery leaves.

query_text: A soup with lentils, carrots, celery, onion and cumin
title: Six Vegetable Salad Recipe
ingredients: 4 or possibly 5 c. frzn peas; 1 lg. cauliflower, sm. pcs; 1 c. radishes, diced; 2 c. diced carrots; 2 c. diced celery; 1 c. minced green onions & tops
directions: 1. Stir dressing into vegetables the day before you serve. 2. Stir up about 3 or possibly 4 times during the day and next morning. 3. Keeps a long time.

query_text: A soup with lentils, carrots, celery, onion and cumin
title: Savory Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 stalks celery; 3 carrots; 1 large onion; 1 can water; 2 cans cream of mushroom or celery soup; 1 Tbsp. flour; 3 to 3 1/2 lb. pot roast; 1 medium sized browning bag
directions: 1. Sear beef (brown rapidly on both sides to hold juice). 2. Place level tablespoon of flour in browning bag and shake well. 3. Place meat in bag. 4. Mix 2 cans of soup with 1 can of water. 5. Stir into the soup sliced carrots, onion and celery. 6. Pour mixture over the roast and tie the bag. 7. Puncture about 3 times with a 2-tined fork (allow steam to escape). 8. Place in 325° oven and bake 1 hour and 45 minutes. 9. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice. 10. Gravy is in the bag.

query_text: A soup with lentils, carrots, celery, onion and cumin
title: Homemade Chicken Stock
ingredients: 8 pounds Chicken Pieces (carcasses, Wings, Whole Chickens, Etc); 6 whole Carrots, Washed And Cut Into Large Chunks; 4 whole Celery Stocks (leaves And All), Washed And Cut Into Large Chunks; 1 whole Medium Onion - Quartered; 10 sprigs Fresh Dill; 20 sprigs Fresh Thyme, Oregano, And/or Rosemary; 10 whole Peppercorns; 6 cloves Garlic
directions: 1. Throw everything into a large stockpot or Dutch oven (I use a 20 quart stockpot) and cover with water. 2. Bring to a boil and let it simmer for 4 6 hours. 3. Strain stock through a fine-mesh strainer into another container. 4. Let it chill overnight or until fat solidifies on top. 5. Remove fat. 6. Use immediately, or place in plastic containers/zip-top bags and freeze for other recipes that call for chicken stock.

query_text: Oats, honey, peanut butter and chocolate chips, no oven
title: Healthy Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 2/3 cup oatmeal; 1 egg; 3 tablespoons peanut butter; 1/4 cup sugar; 1 splash milk
directions: 1. Gather ingredients. 2. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. 3. Combine the peanut butter and sugar. Mix. 4. Combine with the eggs until well blended. 5. Add oatmeal. Mix well. 6. Add a splash of milk. 7. Spoon into small cookies on a cookies sheet lined with paper. 8. Bake in the oven for 15-25 minutes or until the outside is slightly brown. 9. Let cool and Enjoy!

query_text: Oats, honey, peanut butter and chocolate chips, no oven
title: O'Henry Bars(No Bake)
ingredients: 4 c. oatmeal; 1 c. butter; 3/4 c. peanut butter; 1/2 c. corn syrup; 1 c. chocolate chips; 1 c. sugar
directions: 1. Mix together the oatmeal, corn syrup, butter and sugar and press into a buttered 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

When chilled, remove the pan from the fridge and use the waxed paper overhang to lift the rectangle out of the baking pan. 21. It will come out as one big, pliable piece. 22. directions: 1. Combine chicken and 1/4 cup oil in large bowl. 2. Add garlic, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 5 teaspoons cumin, and lemon peel. 3. Rub mixture into chicken to coat. 4. Cover and refrigerate overnight. 5. Preheat oven to 400F. 6. Combine remaining 6 tablespoons oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon cumin, pita bread, parsley, tomatoes, green onions, and 1/2 cup mint in large bowl. 7. Season salad with salt and pepper. 8. Cover and refrigerate while cooking chicken. 9. Transfer chicken from marinade to rimmed baking sheet; sprinkle with salt. 10. Bake chicken 10 minutes; turn over and bake until cooked through, about 10 minutes longer. 11. Place chicken on cutting board; slice each breast crosswise into 5 pieces. 12. Arrange salad on large platter. 13. Place chicken atop salad; pour any drippings from baking sheet over chicken. 14. Garnish with remaining 2 tablespoons mint.

query_text: Ground lamb, mint, yogurt, cumin, garlic, onion, pita bread and cucumber
title: Better Than Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 cup chickpeas, rinsed; 13 cup plain greek plain fat-free yogurt; 14 cup of fresh mint, chopped; 1 garlic clove, crushed; salt; fresh pepper
directions: 1. Process the chickpeas in a mini-chopper or food processor. 2. Combine with all other ingredients. 3. Taste and adjust the seasonings. 4. Cover and put in the fridge for up to a week. 5. (This is good with other fresh herbs too, such as fresh chopped basil or cilantro).

query_text: Ground lamb, mint, yogurt, cumin, garlic, onion, pita bread and cucumber
title: Lamb and Yoghurt Patties
ingredients: 400 g ground lamb (NZ lamb is the best); 2 tablespoons plain yogurt; 12 teaspoon salt; 12 teaspoon cumin; 12 teaspoon ground coriander; 1 pinch cayenne; 1 pinch black pepper; 2 teaspoons oil or 2 teaspoons butter, if needed; 1 spring onion, sliced; 1 clove garlic, crushed; 1 large tomatoes, diced; salt and pepper; mint or coriander leaves
directions: 1. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl, using your hand or a fork. 2. Form into four flattish patties and put on a plate. 3. Heat a heavy fry pan until very hot and add just enough oil or clarified butter to make the bottom of the pan shine. 4. Place the patties in the pan and fry on the first side until deep brown on the bottom, then turn and fry the second side until the patty is barely pink in the middle. 5. Lift the patties out onto a warm plate while you make a simple pan sauce. 6. If there is no fat in the pan, add a couple of teaspoons, then fry the spring onion and garlic until it softens, then add the tomato and warm through. 7. Season and stir in the mint or coriander. 8. Divide the sauce between two warmed plates and place the patties on top.

query_text: Ground lamb, mint, yogurt, cumin, garlic, onion, pita bread and cucumber
title: Lamb Korma
ingredients: 1 kg boneless lamb, cut into 3cm cubes; 1 medium onion, chopped; 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, grated; 3 garlic cloves, roughly chopped; 1 tablespoon coriander seed; 2 teaspoons ground cumin; 1 teaspoon cardamom pod; 1/2 teaspoon salt; 1 teaspoon chili flakes, depending on taste (less (or more); 2 tablespoons ghee; 1 medium onion, extra, sliced; 2 tablespoons tomato paste; 1/2 cup yoghurt
directions: 1. Put the onion, ginger, garlic, coriander seeds, cumin, cardamom, salt and chili flakes into a food processor and process until a smooth paste forms (or use a mortar and pestle). 2. Add the spice mix to the lamb and stir well to coat. Set aside for 1 hour. 3. Heat ghee in a large pan or wok. Add the extra onions and cook, stirring over moderate heat until the onions soften. 4. Add the lamb and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring constantly,until the lamb cubes are browned all over. 5. Add the tomato paste and 2 tablespoons of the yoghurt and stir until combined. 6. Simmer uncovered until the liquid is absorbed. 7. Add the remaining yoghurt, 2 tablespoons at a time, stirring between each addition until the liquid is absorbed. 8. Cover the pan and simmer over a low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. 9. Serve with rice, raitas and relishes.

query_text: Ground lamb, mint, yogurt, cumin, garlic, onion, pita bread and cucumber
title: Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 European cucumber or 3 Persian cucumbers, finely chopped or grated; Salt; 2 cups drained yogurt; 2 to 3 garlic cloves, cut in half, green shoots removed, and mashed to a paste in a mortar and pestle with 1/4 teaspoon salt; 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint (more to taste); Freshly ground pepper; 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil (optional)
directions: 1. Toss the cucumber with a generous amount of salt and leave in a colander in the sink to wilt for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Rinse and drain on paper towels. 3. Beat together the yogurt, garlic, mint, salt and pepper to taste, and olive oil. 4. Stir in the cucumbers. 5. Adjust seasonings and serve.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Vegetable Almond Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon plus 2 tablespoons peanut oil or canola oil; 2 large eggs, beaten; 1 large bunch broccoli, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces; 1 large onion, chopped (about 2 cups chopped); 2 large carrots, sliced on the diagonal or diced; 1/2 teaspoon salt; 1/2 pound firm tofu, diced, or 1 cooked chicken half breast, diced; 1 small (6-inch) zucchini or yellow summer squash, diced; 1 to 2 tablespoons minced garlic; 3 cups cooked long-grain brown rice (see Notes); 1 cup peas (frozen/defrosted); 4 medium scallions, minced (whites and greens); Low-sodium soy sauce; 1 cup coarsely chopped or slivered almonds, lightly toasted; Extra soy sauce; Chinese-style toasted sesame oil; Red pepper flakes and/or chili oil
directions: 1. Place a large wok or skillet over medium heat and wait about 30 seconds. 2. Add 1 teaspoon oil and swirl to coat the pan. 3. Add the beaten eggs, and slowly tip the pan in all directions, allowing the eggs to spread into a thin layer. 4. Keep tilting until the eggs have reached their limit and are cooked through. 5. Use a spatula to transfer the cooked eggs to a plate, then cut the eggs into small pieces or strips with a dinner knife. 6. Wipe the wok or skillet clean with a paper towel and return it to high heat. 7. Wait another 30 seconds, then add 2 tablespoons oil and swirl to coat the pan. 8. Add the broccoli, onion, carrots, and salt, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. 9. Add the tofu or chicken, zucchini or summer squash, and more or less garlic, depending on your taste. 10. Turn the heat down to medium, and stir-fry another 3 minutes or so, until the vegetables are all tender-crisp. 11. Fork in the rice a little at a time, as you keep the mixture moving over medium heat. 12. When all the rice is in, dump in the peas and scallions, and shake in about 20 good shakes of soy sauce, as you stir and cook for just a minute longer. 13. Stir in the almonds. 14. Serve hot, and pass shakers of condiments.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Hot and Spicy Tofu
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanut oil; 1 pound firm tofu, cubed; 1 red onion, sliced; 1 red bell pepper, sliced; 1 green chile pepper, chopped; 3 cloves garlic, crushed; 1/3 cup hot water; 3 tablespoons white vinegar; 3 tablespoons soy sauce; 1 tablespoon brown sugar; 1 teaspoon cornstarch; 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
directions: 1. Heat peanut oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. 2. Toss the tofu into the oil, and cook until browned on all sides. 3. Once browned, toss in onion, bell pepper, chile pepper, and garlic; cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. 4. In a small bowl, whisk together the hot water, vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, and red pepper flakes. 5. Pour over tofu and vegetables, toss to coat, and simmer 3 to 5 minutes, or until sauce thickens slightly.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Steamed Broccoli
ingredients: 3 pounds fresh broccoli; 1/4 cup lemon juice
directions: 1. Trim off large leaves of broccoli, and remove tough ends of lower stalks. Wash broccoli thoroughly, and separate into spears. Arrange in steaming rack with stalks to center of rack. Place over boiling water; cover and steam 15 minutes. 2. Sprinkle with lemon juice before serving.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Baked Tofu With Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 block (14 ounces) extra firm tofu; 4 tablespoons low-sodium soy sauce; 2 tablespoons canola or sesame oil; 1 red bell pepper, seeded and sliced; 8 stalks fresh asparagus; hot pepper oil ***; optional: sliced green onions and /or black sesame seeds for garnish
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. 2. Drain the tofu of excess water. Cut the block of tofu in half horizontally, and in half again to make four "steaks." Place between paper towels and press to get any remaining water out. 3. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and oil. Place the tofu on the baking sheet and brush with the marinade. Let sit for at least twenty minutes or up to two hours in the fridge, letting the juices soak in. 4. Toss the asparagus and red pepper in 1/2 tablespoon olive oil and arrange on the baking sheet next to the tofu slices. Season everything with a generous sprinkling of sea salt and freshly ground pepper. 5. Bake in the oven for about one hour, turning once, until tofu is golden and crispy. The edges should look crispy and glazed and the vegetables should be caramelized. Brush any extra sauce over top if necessary. 6. Remove from the oven and plate the tofu slices with the vegetables. Serve with a drizzling of hot pepper oil. 7. *** Make your own hot pepper oil by heating 5 tablespoons olive oil and 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper in a small saucepan until the oil starts to bubble and brown. Place in a lidded container and set aside for a few days so the infusion has time to really come alive and age. Use sparingly to add flavor and spice to any dish. But be careful, this is going to be spicy!

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Broccoli In Oyster Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 1 bn Chinese broccoli (gai larn) (available at Chinese stores); 6 c. boiling water mixed with; 1 tsp salt and also; 1 Tbsp. groundnut/peanut oil (or possibly 6 c. light chicken broth/stock); 1 Tbsp. chicken broth (stock); 1/4 c. oyster sauce (available at Chinese stores)
directions: 1. Trim each stalk of broccoli. 2. Use only the top 6 inches of each broccoli stalk. 3. Throw away the leaves except for the young leaves at the tips. 4. Wash the broccoli under cool running water, and pat dry with paper towels. 5. Bring the water to a rolling boil. 6. Add in the broccoli and boil over high heat for 2 to 3 min. 7. Meanwhile, gently simmer together the 1 Tbsp. 8. chicken broth and oyster sauce. 9. Strain the broccoli out of the water, arrange neatly on a serving plate and cut the stalks in halves with a pair of scissors. 10. Spoon the oyster sauce over the broccoli greens and serve. 11. This recipe yields 4 servings. 12. Comments: Chinese broccoli, or possibly kale, does not resemble Italian broccoli, that is a member of the cabbage and cauliflower family. 13. It is, instead, a stem vegetable with small white flowers and dark green leaves. 14. The stems are slender and juicy, while the leaves have a slightly bitter taste. 15. This vegetable was cultivated originally in China's southern states, particularly Guangzhou (Canton), but is now grown in most parts of China.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Peanut Noodles with Gingered Vegetables and Tofu
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil; 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger; 8 ounces broccoli, tops cut into florets, stems peeled, cut into thin strips; 1 large carrot, peeled, cut into thin strips; 1 celery stalk, thinly sliced; 8 green onions, white parts cut into thin strips, green parts chopped; 1 medium zucchini; 1 medium-size yellow crookneck squash, cut lengthwise in half, then crosswise into 1/3-inch-thick slices; 1 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips; 2 tablespoons dry Sherry; 10 ounces extra-firm or firm tofu, cut into 1/2-inch pieces; 12 ounces spaghetti, freshly cooked; Chinese Peanut Sauce; 1 cup lightly salted roasted peanuts
directions: 1. Heat peanut oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. 2. Add ginger and stir 30 seconds. 3. Add broccoli, carrot and celery and saute 5 minutes. 4. Add white parts of green onions, zucchini, yellow squash, bell pepper and Sherry and saute until vegetables are crisp-tender, about 3 minutes longer. 5. Add tofu and stir gently until heated through, about 2 minutes. 6. Season to taste with salt and pepper. 7. Place spaghetti in large bowl. 8. Add Chinese Peanut Sauce and toss to coat. 9. Transfer to platter. 10. Top with vegetable mixture. 11. Sprinkle with peanuts and chopped green parts of green onions.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Thai Pad Pra Ram
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, cubed (drained and cubed) or 4 vegetarians substitute tofu (drained and cubed); 1 (8 ounce) can baby corn; sliced fresh mushrooms (or one can, drained); 1 bunch broccoli floret (cut); 1 (227 ml) can water chestnuts; jasmine rice (prepared by instructions); satay peanut sauce (or Thai Peanut sauce prepared with coconut milk)
directions: 1. Heat a slightly oiled wok/skillet (medium/high). Stir fry chicken until no longer pink. Prepare the rice while stir frying the chicken. 2. Add vegetables to chicken in wok/skillet and stir fry for approximately 3 minutes (too long and the vegetables will become soggy). When done, you can place a serving of rice on plate with stir fry on top, then add Satay or Thai Peanut sauce to the top. If you prefer, you can also combine just the vegetables and sauce. This is my variation on my favorite dish at my favorite Thai establishment.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Chanpuruu with Firm Tofu
ingredients: 1/2 block Firm tofu; 100 grams Thinly sliced pork; 1/3 Carrot; 1/2 Onion; 1/2 pack Bean sprouts; 2 Green peppers (small); 1 tsp Chicken soup stock granules; 1 dash each Salt and pepper; 1 tbsp Soy sauce; 1 tsp Sesame oil (for stir-frying)
directions: 1. Drain excess water from the tofu. 2. (Alternatively, cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces, and lightly sprinkle with salt. 3. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes uncovered, then allow it to cool.) 4. Cut the vegetables into thin strips. 5. Heat the sesame oil in a frying pan, and fry the pork well. 6. Once the pork has browned, add the carrot, onion, green peppers, and bean sprouts, in that order, and stir-fry. 7. Add the chicken soup stock granules, salt and pepper, and mix them well. 8. Add the tofu. 9. Heat the tofu while stirring gently, so that the tofu won't break apart. 10. Once the tofu has cooked through, evenly drizzle the soy sauce into the pan. 11. When everything has seasoned well, it's done! 12. Adjust the amount of soy sauce to taste.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Chicken Kabobs With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (about 1 1/2 lb.); 1/4 c. soy sauce; 1 Tbsp. vegetable oil; 1 tsp. packed brown sugar; 1 tsp. ground ginger; 1 clove garlic, minced; Peanut Sauce (see following)
directions: 1. Cut chicken into 3/4-inch pieces. In a large bowl, mix together soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger and garlic. Add chicken pieces to mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. colored spiral noodles; 1 stalk fresh broccoli; 1 tomato; 1 purple onion; 1 bottle olive oil salad dressing; salt to taste
directions: 1. Cook noodles according to package directions. 2. Add a little salt to noodles. 3. After noodles are done, drain them in strainer. Pour noodles in a bowl and cut up broccoli, tomato and onion; add to noodles. 4. Pour salad dressing over noodles and mix well. Refrigerate before serving.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Stir-Fry Vegetables With Tofu
ingredients: 1/2 lb. tofu, cut into 1/2-inch cubes (firm or extra firm is best); 3 Tbsp. soy sauce; 1 tsp. vinegar; 1/4 tsp. cumin; 2 cloves garlic, minced; 1/2 tsp. grated ginger; 3 Tbsp. peanut or salad oil; 1 large carrot, chopped; 2 c. chopped broccoli; 1 c. sliced mushrooms; 1/2 c. sliced green onions; 3 Tbsp. cilantro (optional); use any vegetables that are your favorites; crispy noodles
directions: 1. Place tofu in shallow bowl. 2. Mix soy, vinegar, cumin, garlic and ginger; drizzle this over tofu and set aside. 3. Heat oil in wok or large pan over high heat. 4. Add carrot and stir-fry 1 minute. Add broccoli and cook 2 minutes, then add mushrooms and onions. Reduce heat to medium. 5. Add tofu mixture and cook, stirring gently until heated through but vegetables are still crisp. 6. Garnish with cilantro. 7. Spoon over hot rice and pass the soy sauce and add crispy noodles on top.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Easy Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 C water; 1 pkg dry Lipton Onion Soup mix; 6 C broccoli
directions: 1. In skillet, combine water and soup mix. 2. Add broccoli. Simmer, covered until broccoli is done.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Broccoli And Cheese Stuffed Potato Recipe
ingredients: 4 ounce Potato baked; 1/2 c. broccoli cooked; 3/4 ounce cheddar cheese, lowfat shredded * see note
directions: 1. 1. 2. Top baked potato with broccoli & cheese. 3. 2 Broil Till cheese melts. 4. * Recipe called for regular cheddar cheese shredded. 5. Pamela 6. Serves 1

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Creamy Vegan Pesto Pasta With Broccoli
ingredients: 7 ounces firm tofu; 1 cup raw cashews; 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed (or fresh spinach tastes really nice and keeps more nutrients!); 2 garlic cloves; 2 tablespoons olive oil; 1 1/2 teaspoons salt; 1 medium onion, chopped; 1 (500 g) package egg-free pasta (I usually use bow tie, but it would be great with penne also); 1/2 cup water; 3/4 cup water; 1/3 cup water; 2 teaspoons vegetarian poultry seasoning (I use McKays Vegan Chicken Seasoning); 1 1/2 tablespoons nutritional yeast; 3 tablespoons pesto sauce, liquid (can add more to taste); 1 medium head of broccoli, cooked
directions: 1. In a blender or food processor, blend cashews and 1/2 cup water until smooth. Then add the tofu, 1 tablespoons olive oil (reserve 1 Tbsp), 3/4 cup water, vegetarian chicken seasoning, 1 1/2 Tbsp nutritional yeast, and salt, and blend until smooth and creamy. You may want to add a tad more water if it's too thick. Set aside. 2. Boil pasta noodles and drain. 3. In a large saucepan, saute the onion and garlic in the remaining 1 tablespoons olive oil until onions are clear. Add 1/3 cup water and the vegan chicken seasoning. If you are using fresh spinach, cook it with the onion, if using frozen spinach add it to the saucepan after the onion is clear. 4. Once the onion, garlic, and spinach is cooked and the water has been evaporated, add the blended mixture (cashews, tofu, etc), cooked broccoli, and pesto sauce to the sauce pan. Cook together on low for 5 minutes. 5. Serve mixed sauce on top of cooked pasta and enjoy!

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Thanksgiving for 10: Greens
ingredients: 3 lbs broccoli; 4 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds; 12 cup toasted, chopped almonds; soy sauce
directions: 1. Steam broccoli until tender. 2. Add sesame seeds and then almonds. 3. Add soy sauce to taste. 4. Serve immediately.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Cran-Orange Smoothie
ingredients: 12 cup dried cranberries; 14 cup orange juice, fresh squeezed; 14 cup soft tofu; 1 orange, seeded; 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated or 1 teaspoon ground ginger; 1 tablespoon honey
directions: 1. Using a blender or Vita-Mix, process all ingredients until smooth. 2. Pour into a glass.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Savory Broccoli Spears
ingredients: 2 tablespoons slivered or sliced almonds; 2 tablespoons butter; 1 pound fresh broccoli, cut into spears; 1/3 cup chicken broth or water; 2 teaspoons soy sauce; 1/8 teaspoon pepper
directions: 1. In a skillet, saute almonds in butter until golden brown. Remove; set aside. Add remaining ingredients to skillet. Cover; cook over medium heat for 8-10 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender. Sprinkle with almonds.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Sesame Garlic Broccoli S-C-J
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds; 20 ounces broccoli (1 1/4 lbs); 2 fresh garlic cloves, chopped fine; 3 teaspoons sesame oil; 1 tablespoon chili sauce (or your favorite hot sauce); 3 teaspoons light soy sauce
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Spread the sesame seeds in a single layer on a cookie sheet. 3. Bake in the oven for 12 minutes until fragrant and golden brown. 4. When done, remove from hot pan into medium bowl to stop cooking. 5. Mix the chopped garlic, sesame oil, chili sauce, and soy sauce. 6. Using a vegetable peeler, peel the stalks of broccoli. 7. Quarter the broccoli stalks lengthwise. 8. Steam the broccoli in a vegetable steamer over water until it reaches desired tenderness. 9. *If you like broccoli a little crunchy, steam for about 2 minutes. 10. Remove broccoli and place in serving bowl. 11. Drizzle the sauce over it and mix well. 12. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds. 13. TIP: 14. This vegetable dish keeps well and is delicious cold. Keep it airtight in your refrigerator.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Weight Watchers Vegetable-Peanut Stir-Fry - 5 Points
ingredients: 2 teaspoons peanut oil; 2 cups onions, chopped (about 1 large onion); 2 cups bok choy, chopped; 2 cups carrots, chopped (about 2 medium carrots); 1 medium green pepper, chopped; 1 medium sweet red pepper, chopped; 8 ounces mushrooms, thinly sliced; 2 cups broccoli, florets; 2 cups asparagus, cut into 2-inch peices (about 1/2 pound asparagus); 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce; 2 teaspoons cornstarch; 1/4 cup canned reduced-sodium chicken broth; 8 tablespoons peanuts, dry roasted, chopped; 4 cups cooked brown rice, kept hot
directions: 1. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add onion, bok choy, carrots, peppers, mushrooms, broccoli and asparagus; cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently. 2. Add soy sauce and cook until vegetables are crisp-tender, about 2 minutes more. 3. Whisk cornstarch into broth in a small cup and add to pan; simmer until sauce thickens, about 1 minute. 4. Spoon stir-fry onto rice on individual plates and top each serving with peanuts. Yields about 1 1/2 cups of vegetables, 1 tablespoon of peanuts and 1/2 cup of rice per serving.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Vegetable Fried Rice With Tofu
ingredients: 1 cup rice; 1/4 cup spring onions; garlic minced / chopped 2 table spoons; 1/2 veggies; pepper powder for taste; tofu soft chopped 1/2 cup; 1 teaspoon garlic powder; salt a little; 1 chili sauce; 2 oil; 1 soya sauce
directions: 1. Heat a wok or saute pan , add oil, when ready throw in spring onions and garlic pieces 2. When garlic pieces turn light brown add in the mixed veggies, fry for 4 to 5 minutes.Now add in tofu pieces 3. When tofu starts golden browning , add rice, sauces, a little salt , pepper powder,garlic powder and toss well carefully . 4. garnish with chopped spring onions and serve hot . 5. Notes:: You can add broccoli , snap peas instead of peas as original fried rice uses snap peas, meat chunks, asparagus , capsicum You can omit garlic powder , instead add more garlic pieces. Use sesame seed oil instead of your routine oil for extra flavor Fish sauce, eggs, or any Chinese sauce according to your taste can be added for extra taste Rice should be cold , or left over to get best texture to the fried rice, freshly done rice becomes mushy . Use a large wok or saute pan , remember your pan should be hot enough .

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Beef And Broccoli Recipe
ingredients: 2/3 c. A.1. Original Steak Sauce; 1/3 c. soy sauce; 2 x cloves garlic, crushed; 1 x (1 1/2 lb.) beef top round steak, thinly sliced; 1 bag (16 ounce.) frzn broccoli, red peppers, bamboo shoots and mushrooms, thawed Warm cooked MINUTE White Rice
directions: 1. Blend steak sauce, soy sauce and garlic in nonmetal dish. 2. Add in steak, stirring to coat. 3. Cover; chill 30 min, stirring occasionally. 4. Remove steak from marinade; reserve marinade. 5. Cook and stir steak in large, lightly greased skillet over medium-high heat for 3 to 4 min or possibly till meat is no longer pink. 6. Remove steak with slotted spoon; keep hot. 7. Heat vegetables and reserved marinade in same skillet to a boil; reduce heat. 8. Cover; simmer for 2 to 3 min. 9. Stir in beef. 10. Serve over warm cooked rice. 11. Special Extra: Add in 1/2 to 1 teaspoon warm pepper sauce with soy sauce.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Chinese-Style Stir-Fried Broccoli, Carrots and Leeks
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli; 3 medium carrots, scraped; 3 medium leeks, white part only; 1 tablespoon peanut oil; 1 teaspoon finely minced garlic; 1 teaspoon finely minced ginger; 2 tablespoons chicken broth; 1 tablespoon sesame seeds; 1 teaspoon light soy sauce; 1 teaspoon sesame oil
directions: 1. Trim the broccoli, discarding thick stems and leaves. 2. Cut into flowerets. 3. Slice carrots and leeks thinly. 4. In a wok or large saute pan, heat the peanut oil. 5. Add minced garlic and ginger and stir-fry briefly to flavor the oil. 6. Add broccoli, carrots and leeks and toss briefly to mix well. 7. Add chicken broth, cover and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat. 8. Remove cover, raise heat, and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes, until vegetables are tender. 9. While vegetables are cooking, toast sesame seeds in a separate saute pan until they are golden brown. 10. Set aside. 11. When vegetables are done, add soy sauce and mix well. 12. Remove from heat, turn into a warm serving bowl and sprinkle with sesame seeds and sesame oil. 13. Serve immediately.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Italian Tofu
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu; 1/2 cup red wine vinegar; 2 tablespoons soy sauce or 2 tablespoons tamari; 4 tablespoons olive oil; 4 teaspoons dried basil; 2 teaspoons dried oregano; 2 teaspoons dried rosemary; 1 teaspoon dried thyme; 1 teaspoon garlic powder
directions: 1. In a medium sized bowl, mix the vinegar, soy sauce, oil, garlic powder, and herbs to form a marinade. 2. Cut the tofu into 1/2 to 1 inch sized cubes. 3. Add tofu to marinade and toss. 4. Cover and refrigerate tofu for 30 minutes Toss the tofu in the marinate every few minutes. 5. Slightly brown tofu in a skillet over medium heat (you may need to add a little more olive oil). 6. Enjoy!

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: French Banana Toast
ingredients: 1 banana, ripe; 8 ounces tofu; 1 teaspoon oil (I used canola); 34 cup soymilk; 12 teaspoon vanilla extract (I used almond); 1 teaspoon cinnamon
directions: 1. Mix together all ingredients until smooth. 2. Dip slices of bread into batter (I used Farmhouse Bread: http://www.recipezaar.com/144943) , turning to coat both sides. 3. Brown both sides in hot, lightly oiled skillet.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Sprouted Brown Rice Bowl With Carrot and Hijiki
ingredients: 1/2 ounce (about 1/2 cup) dried hijiki; 1 tablespoon soy sauce, preferably tamari more to taste; 2 teaspoons mirin; 1 tablespoon peanut oil or canola oil; 1/2 pound firm tofu, cut in 1/2-by-1-inch dominoes; 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon shredded or minced ginger; 1/2 pound (2 large) carrots, cut in 2- or 3-inch long julienne; Salt to taste optional; 1 1/2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds; 3 cups cooked sprouted brown rice; 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
directions: 1. Place the hijiki in a medium bowl, and cover with water. 2. Soak 15 minutes, and drain. 3. Place in a medium saucepan, and add just enough water to cover, along with 2 teaspoons of the soy sauce. 4. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer 15 minutes. 5. Drain. 6. Combine the remaining soy sauce and mirin in a small bowl, and place within reach of your wok or pan. 7. Heat a 14-inch flat-bottomed wok or 12-inch steel skillet over high heat until a drop of water quickly evaporates from the pan. 8. Swirl in the peanut or canola oil by adding it to the sides of the pan and then tilting the pan side to side. 9. Add the tofu and stir-fry until lightly colored, one to two minutes. 10. Add the ginger, and stir-fry for no more than 10 seconds. 11. Add the carrots, and stir-fry for one minute until they begin to soften. 12. Add the hijiki, soy sauce and mirin. 13. Continue to stir-fry for another two to three minutes until the carrots are crisp-tender. 14. Stir in the sesame oil and rice, and toss together for a minute or two, pressing the rice into the sides of the wok before scooping and stirring. 15. Transfer to a platter, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Tofu Loaf
ingredients: 1 block tofu; 1 large grated carrot; 1 c. chopped scallions; 1/2 tsp. salt; 2 Tbsp. soy sauce; 1 can mushroom soup; 1 c. bread crumbs; 3 to 4 Tbsp. milk; 2 eggs
directions: 1. Mix all ingredients and bake in greased casserole dish at 350° for 45 minutes.

query_text: A vegan dinner with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce
title: Wagon Wheel Salad
ingredients: 3 oz. (1 c.) wagon wheel pasta; 2 c. Green Giant mixture of broccoli, cauliflower and carrots; 1/4 c. mayonnaise; 3 Tbsp. Italian salad dressing
directions: 1. Cook pasta and drain. 2. Rinse with cold water. 3. Cook vegetables as directed on package. 4. Cut these into bite size pieces, if needed. Drain and rinse with cold water. 5. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. 6. Toss gently. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.
